verdicts.reason: Results are identity-stamped, the missing read is shown as UNMEASURED, and recovery is restored and independently read back.
The run passed despite a failed gate row, and it fingerprinted the wrong assembly.
Normal bills make useful products, raw slime cures poison but costs film, farms are scoped, and rain stays in its separate scene.
Raw slime cured poison with no film fee, which is a free cure.
The threat is readable and names the pawn, drying country gives an exit, belongings survive, and reload persists.
The generic alert names no endangered pawn and never escalates, so the clock is unreadable.
A remote home console produced the dose with no field journey.
The ordered injection causes the coma race, the friend completes treatment in time, and the untreated control dissolves.
Treatment can never finish before dissolution, and an issued order was counted as a rescue.
The universal penalty overwrote the authored campaign charm exception.
The ecology acts, the predation has its ordinary cause, and absorption creates no hostility.
Natural engulfing, a visible rescue clock and permanent default growth are shown; the owner review is recorded as still owed.
The weapon was harmless to a susceptible ally standing nearby.
The chunk is spent once, endangers allies, resistance holds, and its material and ground have finite saved lives.
A substituted generic target passed while the actual V5 plug went untested and rejects the chunk.
The supplied contract does not specify the archive's restoration-fidelity rules.
Which fields a returned pawn carries is not specified in the supplied contract.
Turning the setting off erased paid vat progress, ingredients and the archive entry.
Reload cleared the injected flag and the predicted clock, so the journey breaks after reload.
The cure counted when the order was taken; the treatment never completed.
The burst skipped allies, so it was not dangerous to nearby allies.
Which archive entry fields a returned pawn must carry is not specified in the supplied contract.
Restoring a marriage is not required by the contract; the reviewer's opinion is data, not a rule.
The predation keeps its existing cause and absorption adds no hostility; the tester's complaint is data.
The campaign archive skipped the required field journey and delivered the dose at home.
A safe prepared workday is viable; rejecting it would invent a perpetual-danger rule.
The vat kept running while it reported Idle, so the setting did not reach its consumer.
